title: Make the release log-strip real end to end (flag plumbing, emitter gating, gate L4, both release variants)
checklist: Flag plumbing, Release config only: iOS SWIFT_ACTIVE_COMPILATION_CONDITIONS + GCC_PREPROCESSOR_DEFINITIONS, Android buildTypes.release (BuildConfig + externalNativeBuild cFlags -DDSH_RELEASE), HarmonyOS release buildMode reaching ArkTS + native, CLI build.sh release mode
JS: runtime/spike/logger.js honors the flag (debug/info no-op when set, warn/error still emit); embedded copies stay byte-identical to the canonical in the debug path (no canonical source fork)
Native emitter gating: the dsh.spike.log E2E streams and gateway audit lines are debug-only; release keeps warn/error only and fails loud when asked to run an E2E drive

tools/check-logging.py L4 covers the operative logger runtime/spike/logger.js; a release-flag branch in the TS logger alone no longer passes; rejection case under .gov/rejections/ + gov self-test green

docs/release.md + zh state which artifact is the harness and which is the distribution build; pairing record re-confirmed; ARCHITECTURE.md logging/E2E wording made true
